exposure: cervical dilation at hospital admission (early vs. late admission)
outcome: time between hospital admission and delivery
cohort: Pregnant women between 37-41 weeks of gestation with no prior cesarean section and vertex presentation, admitted to City Hospital between May 2020 and January 2021.
finding: Early admission is associated with significantly higher cesarean section rates, prolonged labor durations (time between admission and delivery), and extended hospital stays.
mod_finding: Early admission is associated with significantly higher cesarean section rates (19.0% in early admission vs. 2.5% in late admission).
followup_time: The average hospital stay was 2.8+/-1.3 days for the early admission group and 1.9+/-0.9 days for the late admission group.
